name: Status Page
description: Adds a gorgeous system status page with real-time node monitoring and incident logs.
longDescription: Keep your users informed! The Status Page addon adds a /status route to your panel. It automatically pings each configured node daemon to show live Online/Offline status and allows administrators to easily post maintenance updates or incident logs directly from the UI.
author: sayamcoder
features: Dynamic pulsing Online/Offline node indicators via TCP daemon pings
Automatic calculations of Partial or Major Outages with stylized warning banners
Modern incident logger with severity flags (Resolved, Investigating, Maintenance, etc.)
Seamless dark mode integration using RyzenNodes neutral palette design
Dynamic sidebar menu entry natively auto-registered
installNote: Restart the panel daemon after installation for database migrations and sidebar items to load.
